$comment: Anthropic prices in US dollars per MILLION tokens. OpenRouter prices are fetched live (npm run prices) into openrouter-prices.json. Re-check these against Anthropic's pricing page before the first paid run of each milestone, and update checkedOn.
sources: Spec (docs/SPEC.md, section 2): Anthropic's pricing page, checked 2026-11-19.

Claude API reference bundled with Claude Code (cached 2026-11-03): same input and output prices; Haiku 5.5 costs $0.50/$2.50 above 100K-token prompts (5x); minimum cacheable prefix 512 tokens on both models; Sonnet 5.5 cache reads $0.10.
1-hour cache writes are priced at Anthropic's rule of 2x input. We never ask for them; the ledger flags any that appear.

notes: Thinks by default (adaptive thinking, effort medium). Bot calls must send thinking: {type: 'disabled'}, which is allowed at effort high or below.
Non-default temperature, top_p or top_k return a 400 error.
No assistant prefill: use structured outputs for the JSON reply.
thinking: {type: 'disabled'} returns a 400 error. Turn thinking off with {type: 'between_tools'} at effort high or below.
Its long-context price step isn't confirmed; prompts are kept far below 100K tokens anyway.
